section.placeholder: This section comes in later tasks.

login.title: Staff sign-in
login.enrollText: The admin panel is protected by a second factor. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example, Google Authenticator) and enter the code it shows. If the app already has a FLAGMAN Drive entry from an earlier attempt, delete it: its codes no longer work.
login.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
login.secret: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app:

errors.missingCredentials: Enter your work email and password.
errors.emailFormat: Check your work email: it is written in Latin letters, for example name@flagman.by.
errors.codeOutcomeUnknown: Could not find out whether the code was accepted: the connection broke. Reload the page: if the sign-in went through, it will be restored.
errors.totpInvalid: Wrong code. Check the time on your phone and enter a new code.
errors.challengeExpired: The time to enter the code is over. Sign in again.
errors.enrollmentNotStarted: 2FA setup has not started. Sign in again to get the QR code.
errors.alreadyEnrolled: 2FA is already set up for this account. Sign in again and enter the code from the app.
errors.resetRequired: 2FA sign-in is locked. Ask an administrator to reset your 2FA.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.rateLimitedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.profileFailed: You are signed in, but the profile did not load. Reload the page.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Could not sign in. Try again.

login.logoutFailed: Could not end the session on the server: reloading the page may sign you back in. Please sign out again.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: This section is not available for your role.

audit.staffUnavailable: Could not load the staff list: ids are shown instead of emails.
audit.filterByStaff: Show only the actions of staff member {{name}}

actions.paymentFailed: Payment got no answer from the provider
actions.incidentCarSentToService: Car sent to service from an incident

audit.moreFailed: Could not load more events. Please try again.
audit.invertedRange: "From" is later than "To": swap the dates.
audit.rejected: The server did not accept this log request. Change or reset the filters.

queue.shown: Showing the first {{shown}}; the rest appear as these are decided.
queue.approved: Application approved: the client may now rent.
queue.rejected: Application rejected: the client will see the reason and can submit again.

profile.title: Profile data
profile.hint: Check it against the documents in the photos.

kyc.decided: This application has already been decided.
kyc.notSubmitted: The client has not submitted the application yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.rateLimited: Too many photo views. Try again later.

profileMissing.title: The client's profile is not filled in
profileMissing.text: The application was sent without a last name, first name or date of birth, so it cannot be approved, and the client cannot complete the profile while it is under review. Reject it asking to fill in the profile: the client will then do so and send the documents again.
profileMissing.reason: Fill in your last name, first name and date of birth in the profile as in your passport, and send the documents again.

approve.title: Approve
approve.licenseIssuedOn: License issue date (from the license photo)
approve.hint: The server checks the age and the driving experience against this date and the date of birth.

reject.title: Reject
reject.hint: Say what to fix, for example: "The selfie is blurry, take it in good light".

errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than {{max}} characters.
errors.licenseDateInvalid: The license issue date cannot be in the future or before the date of birth.
errors.requirementsNotMet: The client is too young or has too little driving experience. Reject the application with a reason.
errors.profileIncomplete: The client's profile has no name or date of birth. Reject the application and ask them to fill in the profile.
errors.notPending: Another staff member has already decided this application.
errors.invalid: The server did not accept the decision: check what you entered.
errors.forbidden: Decisions on applications are not available for your role.
errors.failed: Could not save the decision. Please try again.

zones.failed: Could not load the zones. Check the connection and try again.

disableConfirm.title: Confirm disabling
disableConfirm.text: Disable the zone “{{name}}”? It stops counting but stays in the history and the audit log.

cancelConfirm.title: Confirm cancelling
cancelConfirm.text: The changes to the zone will be lost.

form.drawHint: Click on the map to place vertices. Click the first vertex to close the polygon.
form.editHint: Drag the vertices. Click the point in the middle of a side to add a vertex; right-click a vertex to delete it.
form.name: Name

problems.noName: Enter a name for the zone.
problems.noOutline: Draw the zone on the map.
problems.tooFewVertices: A zone needs at least three vertices.
problems.tooManyVertices: A zone may have at most {{max}} vertices.

errors.selfIntersecting: The sides of the zone cross. Press Cancel and draw the zone so that the outline does not cross itself.
errors.tooManyVertices: Too many vertices. Simplify the outline.
errors.tooFewVertices: A zone needs at least three distinct vertices.
errors.outsideArea: The zone goes outside the pilot area around Minsk.
errors.notClosed: The outline is not closed. Draw the zone again.
errors.holes: A zone has only an outer outline. Draw a forbidden zone to cut a piece out.
errors.invalid: The server did not accept the zone. Check the name and the outline.
errors.notFound: The zone is gone: it may have been disabled. Reload the page.
errors.disabled: The zone is disabled and cannot be changed. Draw a new one.
errors.forbidden: Only an administrator may change zones.
errors.failed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.

fleet.mapUnsupported: This browser cannot show the map (WebGL2 is needed). The list and the cards still work.

connection.reconnecting: Lost the connection to the server, reconnecting. The data on screen may be out of date.
connection.failed: Could not get the fleet data. Reload the page; if that does not help, tell an administrator.

card.staleTelemetry: No fresh data from the car: it may be elsewhere by now.
card.noTelemetry: The car has not sent any data yet.

confirm.title: Confirm the command
confirm.commentHint: Goes to the audit log. No phone numbers or emails: give the rental or ticket number.
confirm.rental: A client is using the car now. I understand the command may lock them in or out.

problems.short: The comment needs at least {{min}} characters.
problems.long: The comment may have at most {{max}} characters.
problems.rental: Confirm that you understand a client is using the car.

commandErrors.activeRental: The car has just been reserved or rented. Open the command again and confirm that a client is using it.
commandErrors.duplicate: This command was already sent. Check the state of the car.
commandErrors.unavailable: The car cannot be reached now; the command was not sent. Try again later.
commandErrors.timeout: The car did not answer in time: the command may have run. Check the state of the car before sending it again.
commandErrors.rateLimited: Too many commands in a row. Wait {{seconds}} s.
commandErrors.invalid: The server did not accept the command. Check the comment: it must not hold phone numbers or emails.
commandErrors.notFound: The car is no longer in the fleet.
commandErrors.forbidden: Your role may not send manual commands.
commandErrors.failed: Could not send the command. Check the connection and try again.

tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.failed: Could not load the tariffs. Check the connection and try again.
tariffs.empty: There are no car models yet: add the fleet first.
tariffs.hint: A tariff applies to every car of the model. A change applies at once; rentals already booked keep the prices of their booking.
tariffs.none: No tariff: cars of this model are not rented out.
tariffs.noneReadOnly: This model has no tariff yet. An admin can create it.

problems.format: Enter a number: rubles with at most two decimals.
problems.tooSmall: The hold cannot be zero: enter at least 0.01.

confirm.title: Tariff confirmation
confirm.createText: Create the tariff? Cars of this model are rented out at these prices as soon as it is saved.
confirm.editText: Save a new version? It applies at once. Rentals booked before keep their prices.

history.title: Version history
history.failed: Could not load the version history.

errors.changed: Someone else changed the tariff while you were editing. Load it again and check the prices.
errors.exists: This model has a tariff already. Load the list again.
errors.notFound: The tariff was not found. Load the list again.
errors.modelNotFound: The car model was not found. Load the list again.
errors.invalid: The API did not accept the prices. Check the values.
errors.failed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.
